entities.summary: Abraham Kazen Jr., usually known as Chick Kazen, was a U.S. representative from Texas's 23rd congressional district, the first to serve in that particular position. Elected in 1966, Kazen served until 1985, having been defeated in the 1984 Democratic primary election by Albert G. Bustamante.
